entities.name: UL Information Transfer Procedure
entities.description: Procedure to transfer NAS dedicated information from UE to network, or to transfer F1-C related information from IAB-DU to IAB Donor-CU via IAB-MT in RRC CONNECTED state.

entities.name: ULInformationTransfer
entities.description: RRC message used to transfer uplink information from UE to network.

entities.name: RRC CONNECTED
entities.description: RRC state where the UE has an established RRC connection with the network.

entities.name: NAS dedicated information
entities.description: Non-Access Stratum information transferred between UE and core network.

entities.name: F1-C related information
entities.description: F1 control plane information transferred from IAB-DU to IAB Donor-CU via IAB-MT.

relations.description: The UL Information Transfer procedure involves sending the ULInformationTransfer message.
The procedure requires the UE to be in RRC CONNECTED state.
The ULInformationTransfer message can contain NAS dedicated information.
The ULInformationTransfer message can contain F1-C related information.
